correctness.rationale: The five square classes (t-i) have independent valuations at i in F5, giving a connected 32-sheeted (Z/2)^5-cover of P1 branched at the five finite points and infinity. Explicit diagonal Jacobian rank shows smoothness; Riemann-Hurwitz gives genus17. Character quotient genera are 15 elliptic and one genus-two. Four rational 2-torsion points force each elliptic F5 trace +/-2; N_X(F5)=16 and genus-two trace0 give exactly five +2 and ten -2 elliptic traces. For C*:y^2=t^5-t the nonsquare norm identity in F25 gives N(F5)=N(F25)=6, so by Weil all four Frobenius eigenvalues have square 5, yielding (1-5T^2)^2. Cartier-Manin zero matrix from exponents 2,6,10 excluding 3,4,8,9 gives genus-two a=2; the prime-to-5 isogeny preserves p-divisible groups, hence p-rank15 and slopes 0^15,half^4,1^15. Independent exact finite field arithmetic recovered 16,96,16 over F5,F25,F125 and genus-two six in degrees1,2.
